verdict.rationale: Automatically remediating agent-readiness criteria is a fair capability to ask of a coding agent. The evidence shows related pieces but nothing that evaluates a repository against agent-readiness criteria or fixes failing ones. Those related pieces are AGENTS.md support, known-good environment configuration and Auto-Fix for review comments and CI failures. Auto-Fix covers CI and review feedback, not readiness checks, so the story itself is unevidenced.
